mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT (COMMENT_NO, REF_MNO, REF_BNO, COMMENT_CONTENT, REG_DATE, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_CNO.NEXTVAL, #{refMno}, #{refBno}, #{commentContent}, SYSDATE, 'Y')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COMMENT SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COMMENT_NO, REF_MNO FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{commentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT_REPORT (COMMENT_REPORT_NO, REF_MNO, REF_CNO, REF_RCNO, REPORT_CONTENT, REG_DATE, STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_CRNO.NEXTVAL, #{refMno}, #{refCno}, #{refRcno}, #{reportContent}, SYSDATE, DEFAULT)
